tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /tshogs mchod kyi rim pa yid bzhin

rgya mtsho bzhugs so/ / tshogs gnyis rgya mtsho'i gling las rab 'khrungs shing*/ /sku gsum yid bzhin rin chen dpal 'bar ba/ /rnam bzhi'i phrin las rang bzhin lhun gyis grub/ /rigs lnga bde bar gshegs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang 'dir rgyud don nyi ma'i snying po las/ /tshogs kyi dga' ba bla na med gsungs pas/ /de yi lag len cho ga'i rim pa ni/ /mdor bsdus tsam zhig bdag gis bstan par bya/ /de yang dbang dang gdams pa la sogs pa'i tshe tshogs kyi mchod pa ji ltar bya ba'i rim pa la gsum ste/ tshogs mchod bshams pa dang*/ cho ga'i rim pa/ phan yon bstan pa'o/ /dang po ni/ gnas der bris sku la sogs pa dmigs pa'i rten yod dam/ med kyang rung ste/ rang nyid lhar gsal ba'i phyir ro/ /yod pa ltar na de'i mdun du bshams nas/ dam tshig pa bskyed pa dang*/ ye shes pa gzhug pa dang*/ de la mchod pa la sogs pa bya zhing*/ med na rang gi mdun nam g.yas phyogs su/ phyi'i mchod pa lnga dang nang gi mchod pa sman rag dang bdud rtsis bkang ba'i ka pā la dang*/ bza' ba dang btung ba'i bye brag sha chang la sogs pa bshams la/ sum bha nis bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs te/ stong pa'i ngang las ā+oṃ āḥhūṃ gis bdud rtsir byin gyis brlabs pa tsam sngon du skad cig gis bya'o/ / gnyis pa la/ sbyor dngos rjes gsum las/ dang po sbyor ba ni thams cad tshogs te gral la 'khod pa la las kyi slob mas phyag 'tshal te/ ho/ rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs dang bcas pa dgongs su gsol lo/ /sbyin pa'i bdag pos gtso byas sems can thams cad kyi don du/ chos thams cad ye nas sangs rgyas pa'i rang bzhin lhun gyis grub pa'i dkyil 'khor du ting nge 'dzin zab mos gsal btab ste/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rnal 'byor la gnas par zhu 'tshal/ zhes brjod nas me tog gtor ro/ /de nas bgegs gtor byin nas/

skad cig gis rdo rje sems dpa' bsgoms la yi ge brgya pa bzla'o/ / gnyis pa la lnga ste/ bdag bskyed pa/ mchod pa 'bul ba/ bstod pa bya ba/ nyams chag bskang ba/ tshogs la rol ba'o/ /dang po ni/ bla ma dang dkon mchog la skyabs su 'gro bar byas rjes/ bdag dang mtha' yas sems can rnams/ /ye nas sangs rgyas yin pa la/ /rtog pa'i dbang gis 'khor ba las/ /byang chub mchog du sems bskyed do/ /zhes brjod do/ /chos nyid ye nas sangs rgyas pa yin yang rnam par rtogs pas 'khrul ba'i sems can thams cad sangs rgyas kyi sa la 'god par bya snyam du sems bskyed la/ bsam du med de sems nyid nam mkha' che/ /sems nyid nam mkha' bsam pa kun dang bral/ /bsam tu med pa'i sems nyid nam mkha' ni/ /nam mkha' mi dmigs pa yang dmigs su med/ /ā+oṃ dharmā dhā tu dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ka3haṃ/ zhes brjod pas chos thams cad rang bzhin gyi rdzogs pa chen po spros pa'i mtha' thams cad bral ba'i stong pa nyid du bsam mo/ /stong pa'i ngang las hūṃ bcu brjod pas steng 'og phyogs mtshams thams cad ye shes kyi me ri me dpung du 'bar ba'i klong nas steng 'og phyogs mtshams thams cad rdo rje'i rwa ba dra ba gur bla re mtshon cha'i 'khor lo dang bcas pa'i dbus su/ rang nyid dpal chen por wal gyis bskyed la bgegs la bka' bsgo ba ni/ e ma nga ni rang byung ba/ khro rgyal dpal chen nyid kyi sku/ /dngos grub bar chad byed pa'i bgegs/ /'di ru ma 'dug gzhan du song*/ /ci ste 'gro bar mi byed na/ /mgo bo tshal ba brgyar 'gas shing*/ /lus ni dum bur stong du gtubs/ /ā+oṃ ru lu ru lu hūṃ bh+yo hūṃ/ /zhes pas rgya mtsho'i mthar phyi'i bgegs bskrad pa'i rjes la/ rnam par rtog pa bgegs yin te/ /bgegs ni rang gi sems las byung*/ /ye nas sems nyid dag ce na/ /bgegs zhes bya ba gzhan na med/ /badz+ra ād+ma ko3 haṃ gis nang gi bgegs dbyings su dag nas/

hūṃ steng 'og phyogs mtshams ye shes me dpung 'bar/ /rdo rje'i ra ba dra ba gur dang ni/ /bla bre mtshon cha'i 'khor los nam mkha' khyab/ khro bo khro mo dpal chen rngams pa'i tshogs/ /sprin phung 'khrigs shing hūṃ sgra di ri ri/ /hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ zhes brjod nas/ spros pa la dga' na ting nge 'dzin gsum dang zhi khro'i dkyil 'khor rgyas par bsgoms la/ mi dga' na dkyil 'khor gyi mnga' bdag bsgom par bya'o/ /de'ang stong ba'i ngang las pad+ma dang nyi zla'i dbus su rang nyid gzhi'i kun tu bzang po yab yum mthing ga zhal gcig phyag gnyis mnyam par sbyor bas/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung dang phyag mnyam gzhag tu mdzad pa'i sku las 'od zer kha dog lnga'i snang ba mchod pas/ nam mkha'i dbyings khyab pa'i nang na/ bla ma dang yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs blos 'khyud tshad bsams la/ hūm̐ gdod nas snying po byang chub dang*/ mi dmigs thugs kyi dkyil 'khor las/ /dkyil 'khor thams cad spyan drang ngo*/ / bdag dang dbyer med brten par bzhugs/ /dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ badz+ra sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ zhes brjod pa tsam gyis dbyings nas/ bla ma yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs thams cad skad cig gis byon nas/ bdag dang nam mkha'i dbyings su brten par bzhugs par bsams la/ ā+oṃ āḥhūṃ swā hā/ zhes ci 'grub tu bzlas shing*/ rten yod na'ang gsal gdab par bya'o/ /gnyis pa mchod pa 'bul ba la lnga las/ dang po phyi'i mchod pa ni/ ā+oṃ rin chen me tog spos dang mar me dri/ /zhal zas rol mo'i sprin phung rgya che bas/ /nam mkha'i dbyings kun khyab par blos sprul te/ /bla ma yi dam dkyil 'khor lha tshogs mchod/ / ā+oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe// dh+ru pe/ ā lo ke/ ghan+dhe/ nai wi d+ya/ shab+ta ā hūṃ/ zhes phyag rgya dang bcas te bdag dang rten gyi lha gnyis ka la mchod do/ /gnyis pa nang gi mchod pa ni/ /sman rag bdud rtsis bkang ba'i ka pā la nas mtheb srin gyis 'thor zhing*/

rigs lnga sku lnga ye shes bsgrub pa'i rdzas/ /dza gad sman sbyar rak+ṣa a mṛ ta/ /sku gsung thugs la gus pas mchod pa 'bul/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /sarba pañca a mṛ ta hūṃ hri tha/ /zhes brjod do/ / gsum pa gsang ba'i mchod pa ni/ rdo rje thal mo mnyam par sbyor ba bskyod cing yid kyis phyag rgya dang sbyor ba'i bde ba la dmigs te/ āḥ thabs dang shes rab 'du 'bral med pa'i ngang*/ /bde chen ye shes yum gyi bha ga'i klong*/ /byang chub snying po dgyes mnyam mchod pa yis/ /rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnams mnyes gyur cig a nu rā ga pañca hrī tha/ zhes brjod de/ bzhi pa bla na med pa'i mchod pa ni/ sems nyid kyi don gsal btab la/ hūṃ chos rnams rnam dag sems nyid ngang du gcig sems kyi rang bzhin ye nas rdzogs pa che/ ma skyes brjod 'das nam mkha' yangs pa'i ngang*/ /mi dmigs chos sku'i dbyings su a la la/ /zhes brjod do/ / lnga pa gtor ma'i mchod pa 'di/ raṃ yaṃ khaṃ gsum gyis ma dag pa dang 'bags btsog thams cad sreg sbyangs gtor nas ā+oṃ āḥhūṃ gsum gyis kha dog dang ro bcud phun sum tshogs pa nam mkha' dang mnyam par bsams te/ 'jig rten las 'das pa dang 'jig rten pa thams cad la so so'i sngags kyis 'bul ba'am/ ā+oṃ āḥhūṃ/ phyogs bcu dus bzhi'i dpal ldan rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i bla ma dam pa yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs/ mkha' 'gro sde lnga dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pa 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa thams cad kyi zhal du bha ling ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ nad dang gdon dang bar du gcod pa thams cad zhi nas mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub rgya chen po stsal du gsol/ ces brjod par bya'o/ /gsum pa bstod pa ni/ hūṃḥ chos dbyings ngang las sgyu ma'i skur bzhengs pa/ /dus gsum bla ma 'gro mgon thugs rje'i lha/ /zhi khro rab 'byams ye shes mkha' 'gro dang*/

/bka' bzhin rjes su bsgrub pa'i las mdzad pa/ /dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ces pa la sogs pa bya'o/ / bzhi pa skong bshags bya ba ni/ nyams chag dran pa rnams la gnong 'gyod dang bcas pas thal mo sbyar te/ bdag cag ma rig 'khrul ba'i dbang gyur pas/ /sku gsung thugs dang rtsa ba yan lag gi /dam las 'gal zhing nyams par gyur to 'tshal/ /rang gnong 'gyod pa'i sems kyis mthol lo bshags/ /thog med bag chags 'khrul pa'i dbang gyur pas/ /tshor dang ma tshor nyams chag ci mchis pa/ /thugs rje chen po'i spyan sngar bshags par bgyi/ /tshangs pa don gyi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /bsnyen sgrub ma tshang phud dang gtsang sbra nyams/ /dus su ma mchod le lo bsog 'jog bgyis/ /lta ba ma rtogs sgom pa ma gsal zhing*/ /spyod pa bag med bgyis pa mthol lo bshags/ /bla ma mched lcam rdo rje spun la smad/ /sdig dang nyon mongs rang gar gyur to 'tshal/ /'phral dang yun gyi sgrib pa ci mchis pa/ /rang gnong 'gyod pa'i sems kyis mthol lo bshags/ /tshangs pa don gyi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /ho rang bzhin ngang la nyes pa'i skyon med pas/ /bshags dang bshags par bya ba cung zad med/ /kun rdzob sgyu ma tsam du bshags na yang*/ /gnyis med sems kyi ngang du dag gyur cig /gnyis su bzung ba rang bzhin nyams pa'i rgyu/ /gnyis med dbyings su ye nas lhun grub pas/ / thams cad mkha' mnyam rdzogs pa chen po'i ngang*/ ma skyes rnam par dag pa'i chos nyid do/ /zhes brjod do/ /de ltar dag nas sor chud dus sdom pa gzung ba ni/ thal mo sbyar te/ bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa dang*/ rigs lnga bde bar gshegs pa ni/ /thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /deng nas byang chub snying po'i bar/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum/ /bla ma la yang skyabs su mchi/ /sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags/ /dge ba kun la rjes yi rang*/

/byang chub sems ni bskyed par bgyi/ /rigs lnga'i dam tshig legs bzung ste/ /rdo rje dril bu la sogs pa/ /dam tshig rdzas rnams gzung bar bgyi/ /bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum/ /nam du yang ni mi gtong zhing*/ /rdo rje slob dpon mi spang ngo*/ /rdo rje spun sring rnams la yang*/ /nam yang smad par mi bya'o/ /sems can rnams la 'tshe ba spang*/ /'phags pa rnams la smad mi bgyi/ /theg pa dman la mi brnyas shing*/ /sngags 'chang spang bar mi bya'o/ /bsnyen sgrub las kyi mtha' gzung zhing*/ /dkyil 'khor 'khor lo bsgom par bgyi/ /dam tshig sdom pa la gnas shing*/ /'khrul pa'i bya ba mi bgyid do/ /rang gi sems ni yongs 'dul zhing*/ /phyogs mthar gtugs pa'i sems can gyi/ /don ni bla med bdag gis bsgrub/ /ma grol ba rnams dgrol ba dang*/ /ma bsgral ba rnams bsgral bar bgyi/ /dbugs ma phyung rnams dbugs dbyung zhing*/ /sems can mya ngan 'das la 'god/ /cais pa lan gsum brjod do/ / lnga pa tshogs la rol ba ni/ de nas tshogs kyi yo byad sngar ma bshams na 'dir bshams la/ las kyi slob mas phyag 'tshal te/ ho dgongs su gsol/ snang srid bde ba chen po'i dkyil 'khor du/ /'dod yon rgyan gyi mchod pa rol ba'i phyir/ /tshogs kyi yo byad byin gyis rlob par zhu 'tshal/ /zhes brjod do/ /de nas bla mas nang mchod nas bdud rtsi blangs la mtheb srin gyis 'thor shing*/ raṃ yaṃ khaṃ gis ma dag pa sreg sbyangs gtor nas/ a las thod pa dum bu gcig pa phyed kar la nang dmar ba'i dbus su/ yo byad rnams ā+oṃ āḥhūṃ gis bdud rts-ir byin gy-is brlabs pa'i kha chod zla ba dang nyi ma'i dbus su rdo rje mthing ka rtse lnga pa'i lte bar yi ge gsum las 'od 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas khengs nas/ nam mkha'i dbyings ltar bsam gyis mi khyab par 'phel bar bsam la/

tshogs phud snod gcig tu bcad de dkyil 'khor gyi mdun du 'bul zhing*/ yang bcad nas gtor mar phul la/ phyogs bcu dus bzhi'i rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i bla ma dam pa/ rgyal ba dgongs pas brgyud pa/ rig 'dzin brda yis brgyud pa/ gang zag snyan khung brgyud pa thams cad dang*/ yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs/ mkha' 'gro sde lnga/ dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pa 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa'i mgron thams cad kyi zhal du/ gha na tsakra khā hi/ zhes pas 'bul lo/ /rgyas par 'bul na rtsa ba'i bla ma nas rim pa ltar brjod cing so so'i mtshan dang sngags brjod nas dbul lo/ /de nas las kyi slob mas phyag 'tshal ba sngon du 'gro bas/ rnam lnga 'dod yon bskor ba'i phyag rgya bya zhing*/ bla ma la/ dpa' bo chen po dgongs su gsol/ zhes pa sngon du btang zhing gzhan la de mi brjod par/ 'di ni chos rnams bzang pos ltos/ /'dus pa rnams la the tshom med/ /bram ze khyi dang gdol pa phag /rang bzhin gcig tu dgongs re rol/ /zhes pa'i lan du/ len pa pos kyang phyag rgya de nyid kyis/ /bde bar gshegs pa chos kyi sku/ /'dod chags la sogs dri ma spang*/ /gzung 'dzin rnam par bral ba yi/ /de bzhin nyid la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /a la la ho/ / zhes pas blangs te/ lag sor g.yas dpa' bo lnga/ g.yon dpa' mo lngar bsams la/ phud kyis bla ma yi dam mchod nas/ lus kyi nang thams cad zhi khro'i dkyil 'khor rgyas pa'am/ spyi bor bla ma/ mgrin par yi dam/ snying gar mkha' 'gro bsam gyis mi khyab par bsams pa la mchod pa'i tshul gyis zas la tshim par rol lo/ /de'i dus su zas la smod pa dang shags dang*/ ku co dang*/rtsod pa la sogs pa chos dang mi mthun pa'i rnam pa thams cad spangs la/ phyi snang ba thams cad dag pa'i zhing*/ nang sems can thams cad ye shes kyi lha rang lus dkyil 'khor gyi ngo bor shes pas 'dod yon la longs spyod do/

/ don gsum pa rjes ni/ lo rgyus kyis brda sbyar ba'i 'og tu las kyi slob mas phyag 'tshal te/ ho dgongs su gsol/ mnga' dbang rdzogs pa'i dkyil 'khor du kun tu bzang po'i tshogs mchod rgya mtshos nye bar mchod zin pa las/ slar yang dgongs spyod rgya mtshos rdo rje'i glu dang*/ lhag ma'i gtor ma bsngo ba/ smon lam bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa la sogs pa'i bka' gnang bar zhu 'tshal zhes brjod nas lhag ma'i gtor ma bcad la rol mo'i sgra dang bcas pas/ dbang phyug ma nyi shu rtsa brgyad lang ka mgrin bcu'i tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad la 'bul lo/ /rnal 'byor pa bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa'i las bzhi'i phrin las thogs pa med par 'grub par mdzod cig ces brjod nas/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang*/ /gtso bo'i nus pa ma mchis pas/ /'dir ni bgyi ba gang bgyis pa/ /de kun mgon pos bzod par mdzod/ /ā+oṃ badz+ra satwa sa ma ya ma nu pā la ya/ badz+ra satwa twe no pa tiṣ+ṭha/ dṛ ḍho ma bha ba/ su to ṣ+yo me bha nga*/ su po ṣ+yo me bha ba/ u nu rak+to me bha ba/ sarba sid+dhi m+me pra yats+tsha/ sarba karma su tsa me tsit+taṃ shri yaḥku ru hūṃ/ ha ha ha ha ho/ bha ga wāṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra ma me muñca/ badz+rī bha ba/ ma hā sa ma ya sa twa a/ zhes yi ge brgya pas kha bskangs la/ bsngo ba bya ba ni/ thal mo sbyar la/ bla ma dang yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ he ru ka dpal grong khyer du/ tshogs kyi 'khor los mchod pa yis/ /bdag dang 'gro ba ma lus pa/ /dkyil 'khor gcig tu 'grub par shog

/las bzhi'i phrin las thogs pa med pas rang dang gzhan gyi don gnyis lhun gyis grub cing*/ mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub chen po 'grub par gyur cig ces brjod nas/ ā+oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzod/ /rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol/ /sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang*/ /slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol/ /badz+ra muḥ zhes pas ye shes pa'i tshogs gtor ma'i mgron dang bcas pa gshegs la/ tshom bu la bskyed pa yin na dam tshig pa rang la bsdu/ ras bris la sogs pa yin na gshegs bsdu mi bya ste/ rab gnas kyi mchog tu gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /de nas lta sgom spyod 'bras la sogs bogs dbyung ba'i phyir skabs su nye bar mkho ba rdo rje'i glu blangs nas me tog bkram la/ sa gzhi dang bar snang thams cad bla ma yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs dam can rgya mtsho sprin phung 'khrigs pas/ me tog gi char 'bebs shing shis pa brjod par bsams la mgrin gcig tu/ bkra shis gang zhig dbyings las mi g.yo lhun gyis grub/ / sku dang ye shes 'du 'bral gnyis med rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /gdod ma'i mgon po 'khor 'das kun gyi dpal gyur pa/ /kun tu bzang po rigs lnga'i rgyal ba rgya mtshor bcas/ /ma lus yongs gang bkra shis des kyang bde legs shog /'od gsal snying po spros kun nyer zhi mchog gi lam/ /rnam par dkar la so sor ma 'dres dri ma bral/ /so so rang rig ye shes spyod yul rgya che ba/ /dam chos nyi ma'i bkra shis des kyang bde legs shog /rnam grol yid bzhin mdzod mnga' 'gro ba'i bsod nams zhing*/ /'phags pa'i dge 'dun rig 'dzin dam can rgya mtshor bcas/ /'jig rten las grub mkha' 'gro 'bar ba'i sprin 'phro ba/ /dngos grub mchog stsol bkra shis des kyang bde legs shog /ces pa la sogs pa brjod pa'i mtshams su/ me tog gi char dbab cing rol mo'i sgra dang bcas pa bya'o/

/de nas ā+oṃ āḥhūṃ gis bsrungs nas las kyi rjes bsdus la/ chos thams cad ro mnyam rdzogs pa chen po'i ngang las mi g.yo bar bya'o/ / don gsum pa phan yon bstan pa ni/ bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs rdzogs pa dang*/ dam tshig nyams chags thams cad bskang ba dang*/ dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro 'du ba dang*/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs mnyes pa dang*/ dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs kyis bsrung ba dang*/ 'dir yang tshe ring ba dang*/ nad med pa dang*/ grags pa dang ldan pa dang*/ 'khor dang longs spyod kyi 'du ba rgyas pa dang*/ ci bsam pa thams cad yid bzhin du 'grub pa dang*/ phyi mar bla na med pa'i byang chub thob pa la sogs pa mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub thams cad 'thob par byed pa'o/ /de ltar tshogs kyi mchod pa'i rim pa zhig /mdo tsam brjod las bsod nams gang thob pa/ /de yis 'gro kun tshogs chen gnyis rdzogs te/ /rgyal ba'i go 'phang myur du thob par shog /deng sang 'gro ba tshig nyung don 'dus pa'i/ /tshul la mos phyir nyung 'dus man ngag 'di/ /gangs ri thod dkar mgul du bkod pa yis/ /skal ldan skye bo'i tshogs rnams dga' bar mdzod/ tshogs mchod kyi rim pa yid bzhin rgya mtsho zhes bya ba/ theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor pa klong chen rab 'byams kyis bkod pa re zhig rdzogs so// //dge'o/ / dge'o/ /dge'o// // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ klong chen rab 'byams kyi gsung 'bum/ (9)tshogs mchod kyi rim pa yid bzhin rgya mtsho/ - PAGE 166 -- PAGE 175 - - PAGE 165 -
